import math

MOD = 998244353

def main():
    n, k = map(int, input().split())
    base = [0] * 10
    indices = list(map(int, input().split()))
    for index in indices:
        base[index] = 1
    result = fast_exponentiation(base, n >> 1)
    total_sum = 0
    for val in result:
        total_sum = (total_sum + (val * val) % MOD) % MOD
    print(total_sum)

def fast_exponentiation(array, power):
    if power == 1:
        return array
    if (power & 1) != 0:
        return multiply_precise(array, fast_exponentiation(array, power - 1))
    half = fast_exponentiation(array, power >> 1)
    return multiply_precise(half, half)

class FFT:
    maxk = 21
    maxn = (1 << maxk) + 1
    wR = [0.0] * maxn
    wI = [0.0] * maxn
    rR = [0.0] * maxn
    rI = [0.0] * maxn
    aR = [0.0] * maxn
    aI = [0.0] * maxn
    n = 0
    k = 0
    lastk = -1
    dp = [0] * maxn

    @staticmethod
    def fft_transform(array, inverse):
        if FFT.lastk != FFT.k:
            FFT.lastk = FFT.k
            FFT.dp[0] = 0
            for i in range(1, FFT.n):
                g = -1
                if (i & (i - 1)) == 0:
                    g += 1
                FFT.dp[i] = FFT.dp[i ^ (1 << g)] ^ (1 << (FFT.k - 1 - g))
            FFT.wR[1] = 1
            FFT.wI[1] = 0
            for t in range(FFT.k - 1):
                angle = math.pi / FFT.n * (1 << (FFT.k - 1 - t))
                cosA = math.cos(angle)
                sinA = math.sin(angle)
                p2 = 1 << t
                p3 = p2 * 2
                for j in range(p2, p3):
                    FFT.wR[j] = FFT.wR[j - p2]
                    FFT.wI[j] = FFT.wI[j - p2]
                    FFT.wR[j] + = FFT.wR[j - p2] * cosA - FFT.wI[j - p2] * sinA
                    FFT.wI[j] = FFT.wR[j - p2] * sinA + FFT.wI[j - p2] * cosA
        for i in range(FFT.n):
            d = FFT.dp[i]
            if i < d:
                FFT.aR[i], FFT.aR[d] = FFT.aR[d], FFT.aR[i]
                FFT.aI[i], FFT.aI[d] = FFT.aI[d], FFT.aI[i]
        if inverse:
            for i in range(FFT.n):
                FFT.aI[i] = -FFT.aI[i]
        length = 1
        while length < FFT.n:
            for i in range(0, FFT.n, length << 1):
                wit = 0
                for j in range(i, i + length):
                    tmpR = FFT.aR[j + length] * FFT.wR[wit] - FFT.aI[j + length] * FFT.wI[wit]
                    tmpI = FFT.aR[j + length] * FFT.wI[wit] + FFT.aI[j + length] * FFT.wR[wit]
                    wit += 1
                    FFT.aR[j + length] = FFT.aR[j] - tmpR
                    FFT.aI[j + length] = FFT.aI[j] - tmpI
                    FFT.aR[j] += tmpR
                    FFT.aI[j] += tmpI
            length <<= 1

    @staticmethod
    def multiply_precise(a, b):
        baseVal = int(math.isqrt(MOD))
        a1 = [x % baseVal for x in a]
        a2 = [x // baseVal for x in a]
        b1 = [x % baseVal for x in b]
        b2 = [x // baseVal for x in b]
        r11 = multiply(a1, b1)
        r12 = multiply(a1, b2)
        r21 = multiply(a2, b1)
        r22 = multiply(a2, b2)
        res = [0] * len(r11)
        for i in range(len(r11)):
            res[i] = (baseVal * baseVal * r22[i] + baseVal * (r12[i] + r21[i]) + r11[i]) % MOD
        return res

def multiply(a, b):
    n = 1
    while n < len(a) + len(b):
        n <<= 1
    FFT.n = n
    FFT.k = n.bit_length() - 1
    FFT.aR = [0.0] * n
    FFT.aI = [0.0] * n
    FFT.wR = [0.0] * n
    FFT.wI = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(len(a)):
        FFT.aR[i] = float(a[i])
        FFT.aI[i] = 0.0
    for i in range(len(b)):
        FFT.aR[i] = float(b[i])
        FFT.aI[i] = 0.0
    FFT.fft_transform(FFT.aR, False)
    FFT.fft_transform(FFT.aI, False)
    for i in range(n):
        FFT.aR[i] = FFT.aR[i] * FFT.aR[i] - FFT.aI[i] * FFT.aI[i]
        FFT.aI[i] = 2 * FFT.aR[i] * FFT.aI[i]
    FFT.fft_transform(FFT.aR, True)
    result = [0] * len(a + b - 1)
    for i in range(len(result)):
        result[i] = int(round(FFT.aR[i] / n))
    return result

    main()
